stories.title: Kroenke buying Angels; sale for $4B, sources say
stories.summary: Stan Kroenke has reached an agreement to acquire controlling interest in the Los Angeles Angels from Arte Moreno.

stories.title: Court docs: Tiger plans to change plea in DUI case
stories.summary: Court documents show that Tiger Woods plans to change his not guilty plea in a DUI case stemming from a rollover crash in Florida.

stories.title: SEC chair says league 'will not budge' on NFL rule
stories.summary: Tennessee chancellor Donde Plowman told ESPN on Tuesday that the league "will not budge" on its rule that NFL players cannot return to college.

stories.title: Kaepernick now shuns NFL for 'blackballing me'
stories.summary: Colin Kaepernick told NBC News he prefers to watch college football over the NFL because the NFL is "actively blackballing me."

stories.title: Kushner says he regrets role in WC sell-off plan
stories.summary: FIFA's intended investment partner, Josh Kushner, said he regrets getting involved in Gianni Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan.
